sceneTasks.title: Scene Rules
sceneTasks.hint: Detect a situation and trigger a Mi Home automation scene instantly — no agent involved
sceneTasks.emptyHint: E.g. reading in bed → turn the light on; auto-exit after 1 minute → turn it off
sceneTasks.drawerHint: Matching, debounce and cooldown reuse the rule engine; scenes fire without the agent
sceneTasks.namePlaceholder: e.g. Reading in bed turns on light
sceneTasks.camerasHint: Any selected camera matching the condition triggers (multi-channel cameras bind as one)
sceneTasks.noCameras: No cameras available — add and enable one in Mi Home first
sceneTasks.conditionPlaceholder: e.g. someone is reading in bed (ongoing state)
sceneTasks.conditionHint: Describe an ongoing state, not an assertion like "detected…" (assertive wording makes the model treat it as already true and re-fire constantly)
sceneTasks.sceneNotesPlaceholder: Scene details or cautions for this rule, e.g. only the white floor right of the rug counts; two consecutive frames must show it; shoe shadows / cables / protective film don't count…
sceneTasks.sceneNotesHint: Applies only to this rule and is injected into the perception model with it, clarifying how this rule should be judged and what counts as a hit. Put cross-scene guidance under Settings → Global perception system prompt. Empty = not injected.
sceneTasks.scenePlaceholder: Pick a Mi Home automation scene
sceneTasks.enterHint: Fires only after the condition stays true for the enter-confirm duration; longer = fewer false enters
sceneTasks.exitHint: Fires after the condition stays false for the exit-confirm duration; longer = fewer false exits
sceneTasks.dwellHint: After entering, count down and exit automatically, firing the exit scene. e.g. light on, auto off after 1 minute
sceneTasks.confirmDelete: Deleting "{{name}}" also removes its trigger rule and cannot be undone. Continue?
sceneTasks.triggerHint: Fire the enter scene once manually (debug; no perception needed)
sceneTasks.errScene: Configure at least one action on enter / exit (an automation or a spoken announcement)
sceneTasks.enterTtsHint: After the condition holds for the enter-confirm duration, a speaker says one line; works alongside the automation above.
sceneTasks.exitTtsHint: Fires after the condition stops holding for the exit-confirm duration; also fires on auto-exit.
sceneTasks.noSpeakers: No speakers found under this Mi Home account — bind and connect one in the Mi Home app first.
sceneTasks.ttsPromptPlaceholder: Describe the line you want, e.g. praise today's outfit in one playful sentence, mentioning the colours of the clothes you're wearing.
sceneTasks.ttsTextPlaceholder: e.g. Have a great day, see you soon.
sceneTasks.ttsFallbackPlaceholder: Spoken when no generated line is available; leave empty to stay silent (the automation still fires).
sceneTasks.dynamicTtsUnavailable: Dynamic lines are generated by the perception model on a hit, which needs the real-time perception engine in pure scene-trigger mode. Until then the fallback text (if any) is spoken.
sceneTasks.errTtsPrompt: {{side}}: dynamic announcement needs a prompt or a fallback text
